HandshakeResult.invariant: success values or error, never an implied authorization

PageCursor.security: position only, never an authorization artifact

DevicePage.invariant: errors never become a successful empty page

StockShadowFields.semantic_rule: preserve raw integers without inventing online, offline or physical state

ShadowBatch.invariant: missing states are not filled with offline or success

EventCursor.security: position only, never a bearer token

ActionRequest.request_id_security: correlation only, never a token or authorization artifact

ack_levels.meaning: cloud accepted, device execution not proven
device acknowledgement within a known contract, physical effect not implied
independent validated observation of the physical effect
ambiguous, neither success nor definitive failure
typed rejection without an invented physical cause

implementation_phases.work: freeze contract, threat model and capability matrix
AIDL, Parcelable models, errors, limits and handshake
UID package signature allowlist and revocation
reads, events, actions, gaps and journal
Kotlin models, coroutines, Flow and sample
authorized apps approval and revocation UI

future_tests.required: all Parcelable round trips, nulls, unknown enums and exact size limits
typed errors, version negotiation, downgrade and migration
UID package certificate auth, scopes, device grants, rate limit and revocation
package spoof, wrong certificate, multiple signers, shared UID and rotation
all ack levels, no ack, no automatic physical retry and cancellation, duplicate request ID with same and different payload
two test apps with different signatures, authorized revoked and unauthorized
UID change, package spoof, wrong cert, update and signing rotation
callbacks, gaps, overflow, Binder death, cancellation and leak detection
in-flight action death and UNKNOWN_OUTCOME without replay
no tokens cookies credentials opaque client IDs or secrets in transactions errors or logs
older and newer SDK minor against older and newer server
simulation always visible and no stock failure activates demo

non_goals: HTTP REST WebSocket LAN or remote API
custom signature permission for differently signed third parties
tokens cookies credentials opaque client IDs device secrets or media keys over AIDL or logs
third-party login pairing invitations password changes or sensitive configuration
video audio P2P preview recording calls or media frames over Binder
exactly-once event delivery or total ordering
automatic retries of ambiguous physical actions
presenting demo as QVCloud or local_only as stock compatibility
publishing the SDK or creating a remote repository
claiming that the external service already exists
